This case-sensitive code system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/devicealert-annunciation defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
local LocalThe signal is annunciated on or adjacent to the detecting device (e.g., at the bedside)
remote RemoteThe signal is annunciated at a place away from the detecting device (e.g., at a nursing station)
